comments.author: Payne
comments.body_html:
I want to issue a warning, with the caveat that this very likely isn’t something you can patch out.

There are many loops that do not depend on the game speed or time. The mission timer is one. Stamina regen or depletion is another. Pause with your gun raised and your arm stamina will reduce. Pause while still and neutral and it will recharge.

However, more than any of those is RAM usage. It creates a memory leak, as these numbers continue to tick up in volatile memory. I paused for an hour and a half to eat, and when I returned the game was using up nearly 30gbs of RAM. On the loading pause before returning to the main menu, it took over five minutes to clean the RAM cache and return to normal function.

As controlling what and how the game is utilizing low level memory assignment is probably too risky and out-of-scope for a mod simply supposed to pause the game, it’s worth knowing that a paused game is not stable! You will most likely crash if you try to leave it paused and running for 3+ hours!
